summary: The filing is a 424B5 preliminary prospectus supplement by TETRA Technologies, Inc. for a proposed public offering of $100,000,000 of its common stock, with an underwriter over-allotment option of up to $15,000,000. The price per share is to be determined based on the market, with the last-reported price of $10.36 on June 1, 2026. The offering is underwritten by J.P. Morgan as lead book-runner and Jefferies. Proceeds will go to the company. This is a routine capital-raising equity follow-on offering, not a special situation.
